title: Depression Anxiety Stress Scales, 21-item
description: 21 statements about the past week, each rated 0–3; three 7-item scales.

holder.name: University of New South Wales, School of Psychology (Lovibond)

citation.text: Lovibond PF, Lovibond SH (1995). The structure of negative emotional states: comparison of the Depression Anxiety Stress Scales (DASS) with the Beck Depression and Anxiety Inventories. Behaviour Research and Therapy 33(3):335–343.

scoring.text: Three sums: depression = items 3, 5, 10, 13, 16, 17, 21; anxiety = 2, 4, 7, 9, 15, 19, 20; stress = 1, 6, 8, 11, 12, 14, 18. Multiply by 2 to compare with DASS-42 norms. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.

note: The DASS site forbids modification, sale and public-facing apps that show scores; the recipe here never shows a score to the participant.
